trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0002, which paged on-call.

**Rollback:**
- v2.3.1, the latest release, was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- us-east, us-west and eu-west are all back on v2.3.0. Checks afterward show the service is healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- No approval was needed: v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before, and the approval rule only covers versions that never have been.

**Incident:** The first try to open the incident timed out. Before retrying, I checked the incident list and found nothing had been created, so the retry didn't make a duplicate or page on-call twice. INC-0002 describes the failure, the rollback and the next steps.

**Next steps:** Someone needs to find what broke in v2.3.1 before it's deployed again. It's also worth asking why it reached production at all: the test build (v2.3.1-rc) was already unhealthy in staging.

content.text:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0002, which paged on-call.

**Rollback:**
- v2.3.1, the latest release, was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- us-east, us-west and eu-west are all back on v2.3.0. Checks afterward show the service is healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- No approval was needed: v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before, and the approval rule only covers versions that never have been.

**Incident:** The first try to open the incident timed out. Before retrying, I checked the incident list and found nothing had been created, so the retry didn't make a duplicate or page on-call twice. INC-0002 describes the failure, the rollback and the next steps.

**Next steps:** Someone needs to find what broke in v2.3.1 before it's deployed again. It's also worth asking why it reached production at all: the test build (v2.3.1-rc) was already unhealthy in staging.
